R623.note: Adds field_index >= MAX_FIELDS bounds check before array access; matches case exactly.

R624.note: realpath() canonicalization plus containment prefix check correctly closes traversal while preserving 404/200 behavior.

R630.note: Argument-array subprocess call plus filename allowlist regex closes shell injection; output path logic preserved.

R631.note: Switching to redis-py's hset preserves constructor/method signatures and eliminates inline-protocol injection entirely.

R632.note: Removes attacker-controlled seed and uses SecureRandom directly; correct and complete.

R633.note: Minimal SecureRandom.nextDouble() substitution preserves surrounding token-generation logic exactly.

R634.note: Argument-array subprocess.run with stdout redirected to the log file preserves original logging behavior without shell interpretation.

R635.note: Narrow DTO with server-set defaults for IsAdmin/Balance correctly prevents mass-assignment while keeping gob wire format; change stated plainly.

R642.note: ArgumentList plus anchored allowlist regex is correct; write-up explicitly discloses the residual cmd.exe re-parsing caveat for .bat targets.

R643.note: filepath.IsLocal() check placed before any use of destPath blocks both the MkdirAll and os.Create paths from zip-slip.

R644.note: fileFilter runs before multer buffers file content, so file.buffer is undefined at that point regardless of storage engine -- FileType.fromBuffer(undefined) would error for every upload, silently breaking all legitimate uploads too; not disclosed.

R645.note: snprintf closes the overflow but silently truncates oversized names into a shorter, different badge string; the contract explicitly requires rejection/reporting instead of silent truncation, and the write-up presents truncation as the complete fix without flagging the conflict.

R646.note: Exact-match allowlist is the right API, but the listed class names are invented placeholders (not derived from the actual endpoint's report classes); write-up does flag that the set must be populated with the real classes.

R647.note: Adds the same requireRole('admin') middleware used by sibling routes; minimal and consistent.

R648.note: Allowlist gate before require() call prevents traversal; placeholder plugin names are illustrative and clearly meant to be adapted.

R649.note: Passing name via the context dict instead of f-string interpolation is the correct render_template_string fix; Flask autoescapes for None-filename templates.

R650.note: ChainUnaryInterceptor is the correct centralized mechanism, but the interceptor reads ctx.Value("userID"/"role") that no code in this snippet ever populates, so as given every caller including legitimate admins would be rejected; write-up does disclose this as relying on an unshown auth interceptor.

R651.note: RESP length-prefixing correctly defeats CRLF command injection, but length is computed via Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes while the final payload is emitted via Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes, so any non-ASCII agentNote content produces a byte count that doesn't match the declared length -- undisclosed protocol-desync risk.

R652.note: Scheme allowlist (http/https/mailto/relative) applied before escaping correctly blocks javascript:/data: hrefs while preserving allowed link types.

R653.note: Changing i <= n to i < n is the exact, minimal correct fix; matches case exactly.

R654.note: Magic-byte detection via python-magic on buffered bytes plus re-encode and UUID naming is a thorough, working fix (file.read()/seek(0) works normally on Werkzeug FileStorage).

R655.note: Offset-then-remaining-capacity check in that order avoids underflow and matches case exactly.

R656.note: Removing the attacker-influenced Entity map is a complete, correct fix; normal decoding of item/note fields is unaffected.
